tasks.title: Conversation #42
tasks.transcript:
Woman: Are you all set for your presentation tomorrow?
Man: Almost. I still need to finalize my slides and add a couple more visuals to make it engaging.
Woman: If you need any help, let me know. I'm done with mine already.
Man: Well, it'd be helpful for me to practice my speech in front of someone...
Woman: I'm free at 4:30, if you want to come by my office.
Man: Thanks! I appreciate it. I'd love to get your thoughts before I deliver it to the full audience tomorrow.

questions.stem: What does the man still need to do for his presentation?
questions.analysis: 题干分析 问题询问男士为他的演示还需要做什么，属于细节理解题，需抓住男士对未完成工作的直接描述。 选项分析 选项A：错误。 对话中没有提到为观众打印讲义，属于无中生有。 选项B：正确。 男士明确说“I still need to finalize my slides and add a couple more visuals to make it engaging”，说明他还需要完成视觉资料的准备工作。 选项C：错误。 男士提到需要练习演讲（practice my speech），但并未说演讲稿还没有写，属于无关干扰。 选项D：错误。 对话中没有提到通知同事关于演示的事情，属于与原文无关的干扰项。

questions.stem: What will the man most likely do this afternoon?

options.B: Deliver his presentation to a group

questions.analysis: 题干分析 问题询问男士今天下午最可能做什么，属于推理判断题，需抓住女士提出的时间安排和男士的回应。 选项分析 选项A：正确。 男士说“it'd be helpful for me to practice my speech in front of someone”，女士回应“I'm free at 4:30, if you want to come by my office”，男士表示感谢。说明他今天下午最可能去女士办公室练习演讲。 选项B：错误。 演示是明天进行（tomorrow），而非今天下午，属于时间错误。 选项C：错误。 女士说她自己的演示已经完成了（I'm done with mine already），男士并未表示要 review 女士的演示。 选项D：错误。 男士已经表达了感谢（Thanks! I appreciate it），但这只是口头回应，并非他今天下午要做的具体事情。
